messages:
Priya (sales): Heads up — Veritas Health (large EHR customer) sent an 80‑question security/compliance packet. They require SOC2 + HIPAA, 7yr audit log retention, EU+US data residency, signed BAA, and the ability to run inside their VPC. Can product triage and map asks -> backlog? cc @Elliot @Maya :eyes:

Carlos (support): Uploaded the questionnaire here: https://redwood.share/reqs/veritas-v1.pdf
Top flags from quick scan: 7yr retention, per-user access logs, KMS/HSM, annual pen test evidence, IP allowlist for admin UI.

Elliot (product): Quick triage proposal (high level):
- Must-have (deal blockers): BAA, VPC/private deploy path, immutable audit logs + retention, customer KMS support
- High priority (near-term releases): per-route audit logging, retention config UI, evidence-pack export
- Nice-to-have: consent UI, automated attestation generator
Can Security confirm must-have list and ballpark dev effort? Product will create JIRA and propose launch criteria.

Maya (security): Confirming must-haves. Notes:
- BAA: legal + security to fast-track, should be first deliverable.
- 7yr retention: heavy. Recommend tiered storage (hot last 90d, cold archive thereafter) to control cost.
- Immutable logs: append-only store + periodic signed digests; est 6–10w dev+infra.
- KMS/HSM: CMEK available on Dedicated/Private; hosted needs KMS integration (approx 4w).
- Evidence pack: we can assemble controls mapping; SOC2 audit is external.
Estimated minimal surface for Private path: 8–12 weeks. Hosted path w/ tooling: 12+ weeks.

Jordan (infra): For Private/VPC we need a checklist: 
1) VPC peering / VPN config
2) KMS key onboarding flow
3) Logging bucket with lifecycle rules and immutability
4) Retention enforcement job + restore workflow
We can reuse Dedicated infra but will need per-customer lifecycle configs. Ops impact: expect ~+30% infra cost for multi-year retention and retrieval.

Carlos (support): Draft acceptance criteria for sales (suggested):
- Signed BAA in place
- Customer can deploy in VPC or Dedicated pool
- Logs retained and exportable for 7yrs (documented plan + SLO for retrieval)
- Evidence pack template delivered and verifiable

Priya (sales): I'll set expectations: timeline ~10–12 weeks, stage with Private deployment first. Need a one-pager for execs with scope, risks, and pricing for onboarding.

Elliot (product): Creating JIRA now: https://jira.redwood/browse/REINF-1421 — "Veritas Health compliance onboarding: retention, VPC, KMS, audit logs". I'll break into epics: BAA/legal, infra (retention + KMS), audit logging, evidence pack, hosted integration. Product/security sync tomorrow 10am PT to align. @Maya please bring mitigation options and cost estimate.

oncall-bot: Ticket REINF-1421 created by Elliot (product)

Maya (security): I'll prep a control matrix and a short cost note. Also propose offering a paid "compliance onboarding" package for customers who need long-term retention + evidence.

Priya (sales): +1 to paid onboarding. Contract note from legal: customer expects "evidence and data export within 30 days" — need to confirm retrieval SLOs.

Elliot (product): Draft retrieval SLOs for discussion: 30 days for full export from archive, 72 hours for query access to last 90 days. Can we commit? @Jordan

Jordan (infra): 72h query SLO for 7yr cold archive is risky. Recommend: 72h for hot window (last 90d), 30d for full archive exports. That matches storage/restore realities.

Priya (sales): OK I'll propose that as interim to customer and flag archive export as part of paid onboarding. Thanks all :pray:

Elliot (product): Next steps: 1) Product creates/triages JIRA (done), 2) Security produces control mapping + list of must-haves (Maya), 3) Infra scope and cost (Jordan), 4) Sales to confirm negotiation points and pricing (Priya). We'll review in the sync tomorrow.

Maya (security): Adding one more quick note: consider encrypt-at-rest proof of keys generation and rotation logs in evidence pack. That helps with auditor requirements.

Carlos (support): I'll start a support playbook stub for onboarding including required customer artifacts and runbook for retrieval.

Priya (sales): Thanks team. I'll forward this summary to Veritas and loop in legal for the BAA.
